prev_agent: Pushed. The root cause on this page was a **second bug**: the release detail page (`release-detail.tsx`) was doing client-side version matching (`sr.version === release.version`) instead of using the `semantic_release_id` already returned by the API. With normalized versions (`0.2.1` vs `v0.2.1`), the string comparison always failed. The fix uses `release.semantic_release_id` from the API response to directly fetch the linked semantic release — no version matching needed. Deploy should pick it up in ~4 minutes.
